opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations/institutions hosting the grant. Not individuals without formal employment with the host institution, unaffiliated individuals, schools/FE colleges, undergraduate or master's-led projects, PhD fees, or overseas-led projects (except exceptional cases with UK-focused dissemination).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. Priority theme for 2026: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. Supports research on racial diversity within the UK funded by an endowment supporting work relating to the Commonwealth.
